title: Network Participation Agreements — Tenure Points on the Exit Recovery Share
content:
An ending Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements** is credited, in its exit settlement, for how long it has been in force. Long tenure raises the exit recovery share, which is the share of the capitation payments still due that Cascade expects to recover from them.

**Schedule.** The exit tenure points are set by the whole months from the agreement's effective date to today:

| Whole months in force | Share points added to the exit recovery share |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | 10 |
| 48 or more but fewer than 96 | 5 |
| Fewer than 48 | Nothing |

## Counting whole months

Whole months are the difference in calendar months between the effective date shown on the agreement record and today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the effective date's day of the month.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Effective 1 May, year 1; today 1 May, year 9: 96 whole months, so 10 points.
- Effective 2 May, year 1; today 1 May, year 9: 95 whole months, so 5 points.
- Effective 10 January, year 1; today 9 January, year 5: 47 whole months, so nothing.
